import os

from types import SimpleNamespace

# Helper to construct a minimal span like the other tests
def _make_span(*, scope_name=None, attributes=None):
    scope = None if scope_name is None else SimpleNamespace(name=scope_name)
    return SimpleNamespace(instrumentation_scope=scope, attributes=attributes, parent=None)

def test_extra_llm_scopes(monkeypatch):
    # Ensure env var not set and module is loaded fresh
    monkeypatch.delenv("LANGFUSE_EXTRA_LLM_SCOPES", raising=False)
    import langfuse.span_filter as sf
    importlib.reload(sf)
    # Scope not in default list should be False
    assert sf.is_known_llm_instrumentor(_make_span(scope_name="custom.scope")) is False

    # Set extra scopes via env var
    monkeypatch.setenv("LANGFUSE_EXTRA_LLM_SCOPES", "custom.scope,extra.parent")
    importlib.reload(sf)
    # Direct match
    assert sf.is_known_llm_instrumentor(_make_span(scope_name="custom.scope")) is True
    # Descendant of a provided prefix should also match
    assert sf.is_known_llm_instrumentor(_make_span(scope_name="extra.parent.child")) is True
    # Still true for an original known prefix
    assert sf.is_known_llm_instrumentor(_make_span(scope_name="ai")) is True"
